caseName: Burlington Northern Railroad v. Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers
caseNameFull: Burlington Northern Railroad Co. v. Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of Equal Employment Advisory Council for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Skinner v. Railway Labor Executives’ Assn., 489 U. S. 602 (1989).
